projection_report_binding: Required caller-supplied exact SHA256 of completed real Store projection report; report must bind the exact encoder_inputs.jsonl bytes. No report repair or fallback.
reuse: Hash-pinned bge_m3_shadow.tokenize/encode/memory_snapshot; only bge_m3 branch, no E5 loading, ranking or quality-gate functions
text_contract: Exact actual Store memory.content including typed prefix; original v2 query and exact text + space + goal + trailing space. Preserve order and text SHA256; reject omissions, additions, rewritten or duplicate queries.
artifact_verification: Existing fixed official BGE assets verified by byte count plus Git/LFS hashes via pinned verify function; no downloads or installs
output: All token IDs/masks, exact normalized FP32 vectors and little-endian hashes, input/report/helper/model hashes, per-item tokenize/inference timing and process RSS samples. No hidden tensor dump.
memory_scope: Whole-process /proc/self/status RSS/HWM samples, not exclusive model memory or guaranteed exact monotonic peak; preserve any decreasing HWM observations and report maximum observed RSS only
timing_scope: Single ordered diagnostic; separate artifact verification, tokenizer, model load and per-item encoding. Not cold-start guarantee or balanced performance benchmark.
limits: Encoding only; no Store vector import or retrieval
No answer or no-evidence rejection test
No inherited raw-60 or raw-18 quality gate
No production defaults, labels or original raw experiment files changed
